changelog:
DensAssistant now runs only when it's needed.

The speech model loads when there's something to transcribe and unloads after 10 quiet minutes, instead of staying in memory all day. Screen capture pauses when you've been away from the keyboard and mouse for 2 minutes, or the screen is locked. On a typical PC this cuts memory use from several gigabytes to a few hundred megabytes.

New: do-not-record hours. In Settings, choose a daily window (it can cross midnight, like 22:00 to 07:00) when screen and clipboard capture stay off. Meetings you start yourself still record.
